alt: Apple Mac mini viewed from the front against an orange-to-yellow gradient, showing its compact aluminum enclosure with two USB-C ports and power indicator
story: Apple raised the Mac mini's starting price 50% over two years to $899 for a base 256 GB model; the 1 TB storage upgrade costs $500 more — itself exceeding the machine's original asking price.
why_funny: The whole pitch of the Mac mini was 'cheapest Mac ever' — it now costs more than many laptops, and the storage bump costs more than a second Mac mini used to.
